questions.topic: Aggregating demand for a public good
questions.stem: Translator's note 2 asks why public good demand is summed vertically. Explain.

answer.exemplar: All consumers share the same quantity of a public good, so at each quantity total willingness to pay is the sum of individual willingness to pay, requiring vertical summation.

questions.explanation: Shared consumption means benefits add at each quantity, so demand curves sum vertically rather than horizontally.
